prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling subway platform. On the left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands rigidly, her umbrella closed tight against her side. Next to her, a silver briefcase rests on the dirty tiles, its latches gleaming faintly. In the center, an elderly man with a white beard sits heavily on a wooden bench, his posture slumped in exhaustion. Beside him, a small child in blue overalls points excitedly at the dark tunnel mouth, drawing the old man's weary gaze toward the approaching lights. To the right of the bench, a businessman in a gray suit checks his wristwatch impatiently, his foot tapping a rapid rhythm on the ground. Behind him, a teenage girl with pink headphones leans against a tiled pillar, completely absorbed in her phone screen. Near the edge of the platform, a street musician with a guitar case open at his feet strums a quiet melody, ignoring the rush. A brown dog on a leather leash sniffs curiously at the musician's shoe, pulling gently against the hold of its owner, a young woman in denim jeans. Further back, a couple shares a single newspaper, their heads close together as they read the headlines. Finally, a vending machine hums softly in the background, its glass door reflecting the dim overhead lights. The artist ensures there is no digital signage displaying train times. There is no advertising poster on the walls.
